fact: The LCA 2010/11 annual report states the Government of Lesotho adopted the Lesotho Telecommunications Policy 1999, which led to the LCA being established by Act in June 2000.

The document records that Lesotho adopted the ICT Policy for Lesotho in 2005, which the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation's 2021 review (commissioned by the ministry) examined.

The document states the 2005 ICT Policy has not been implemented since its inception (citing the 2016 State of ICT in Lesotho report), and that the M&E system it envisioned within the responsible ministry was never established for lack of resources; date is the document's published date, 2024-12-30.
The document records that Lesotho adopted the Communications Policy in 2008, an integrated framework for telecommunications, broadcasting and postal sectors.
The World Bank appraisal document states that Lesotho's ICT policy of 2005 is outdated, so an adopted 2005 policy is the one in force.
The document says the 2005 ICT policy is outdated and that it is not anticipated to be updated or in place as of project effectiveness (document dated 22 December 2023, used as the date).
The World Bank digital health assessment describes the Lesotho ICT policy 2021 as currently in draft form (no event date given; document published 2022-03-01 used).
